title: JK Bank Recruitment 2026 – Banking Associate Posts
shortInfo: JK Bank has announced notification for Banking Associate posts. Required qualification: Graduate in any discipline. Last date to apply: 26-11-26.

dates.event: Submission of Online Application (Start)
Submission of Online Application (End)
Payment of Application Fee (End)

howToApply: Visit the Bank’s official website https://jkb.bank.in/ and navigate to the ‘Careers’ tab.
Click on the relevant notification and select ‘APPLY ONLINE’ to open the registration screen.
Choose ‘Click here for New Registration’ and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated.
Fill in the application form carefully. Use ‘SAVE AND NEXT’ to save data and verify details before final submission.
Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), signature (black ink on white paper), left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per specified guidelines.

Upload required documents in PDF format: 10th Certificate, Graduation Certificate, Apprenticeship Completion Certificate (if applicable), Ex-Servicemen Certificate (if applicable), Disability Certificate (if applicable), Sportsperson Certificate (if applicable).
Preview the entire application form before clicking ‘COMPLETE REGISTRATION’.
Proceed to the ‘Payment’ tab and pay the application fee online using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards, or Mobile Wallets.
On successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form.
Click ‘Submit’ to complete the registration process.

howToApply: Register on the NATS 2.0 Portal (www.nats.education.gov.in) before applying. Only candidates who passed graduation on or after 1st April 2022 need to register here. Ensure 100% complete profile on the portal.
Note down the Enrolment ID generated in NATS 2.0 Portal for future correspondence.
Visit the Bank’s website www.indianbank.bank.in and click on the Careers page or visit https://www.nats.education.gov.in and click on ‘Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank – 2026’.
Click on ‘Click here for New Registration’, enter Name, contact details and email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated.
Fill in the application form. Use ‘SAVE AND NEXT’ to save data if unable to complete in one go.

Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20KB–50KB), signature (black ink on white paper, 10KB–20KB), left thumb impression (20KB–50KB), and handwritten declaration (50KB–100KB) as per specifications in Annexure-II.
Preview and verify all details before clicking ‘COMPLETE REGISTRATION’.
Proceed to the ‘Payment’ tab and pay the application fee online using Debit/Credit Card or Internet Banking.
On successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and online application form for future reference.
Do NOT send the printout to the Bank.
